title: Schedule of offences and fines
question: What does FRSC Act 2007 section Schedule say about schedule of offences and fines?
shortAnswer: FRSC Act 2007 s.Schedule — Light/sign violation N2,000; Road obstruction N3,000; Route violation N5,000; Speed limit N3,000; Vehicle licence N3,000; Number plate N3,000; Driver licence N10,000; Wrongful overtaking N3,000; Road marking N5,000; Overloading N10,000; Dangerous driving N50,000; Drunk driving N50,000; No licence N10,000; Forged docs N50,000.
legalExplanation:
**Section Schedule of the Federal Road Safety Commission (Establishment) Act, 2007** provides:

Light/sign violation N2,000; Road obstruction N3,000; Route violation N5,000; Speed limit N3,000; Vehicle licence N3,000; Number plate N3,000; Driver licence N10,000; Wrongful overtaking N3,000; Road marking N5,000; Overloading N10,000; Dangerous driving N50,000; Drunk driving N50,000; No licence N10,000; Forged docs N50,000

This Act established the FRSC with responsibility for road safety management, traffic regulation, driver licensing, vehicle inspection, and accident prevention on federal highways.
practicalOptions: Carry valid driver's licence, vehicle licence, proof of ownership, insurance. Obey speed limits and traffic signs. Do not drink and drive. Stop at checkpoints. Note officer details if fined.
whatToAvoid: Do not drive without licence, exceed speed limit, drink and drive, use forged documents, overload vehicle, bribe officers.
whatToDocument: Officer name, unit, vehicle plate, time, location, fine amount, receipt, photos of documents/vehicle.
whatToDoAfter: Pay fine at designated bank (not to officer). Keep receipt. Contest in court if wrong. Report misconduct to FRSC HQ or PCR Unit.
reviewNotes: Approved after review from FRSC Act 2007 s.Schedule. Needs plain-language review and verification against official gazette.
